breaks: The next number ignores the result files, so after fx stops between a file and its index line the next result reuses that number (result_files.zig nextNumber).
The next number is the highest one in use, so a save replaces an existing N.txt (result_files.zig nextNumber).
A save that keeps the whole output reports a file that was never written, so its index line names a file that is not there (result_files.zig save, the branch without a cut).
A result whose output finds no room is not saved, and its text drops the notice that says so (bash_results.zig writeHeader).
